technology_name: SYSTEM FOR INSCRIBING PATTERNS ON METALLIC NANOPARTICLES LAYER AT LIQUID-LIQUID INTERFACE AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional nanolithography and surface-patterning systems are prohibitively expensive, require high vacuums, and struggle to process delicate metallic nanoparticle films without destroying the substrate interface.
description: An innovative optoelectronic hardware setup engineered with a liquid holding platform, a laser diode, a reflector, and a focusing lens designed to induce high-precision localized thermocapillary flow to shape and pattern self-assembled metallic nanoparticle layers.
applications: Microfluidic sensor fabrication, plasmonic device manufacturing, flexible electronics circuitry, and high-density optical storage media prototyping.
